phrasings.literal: Which tasks in the asset pipeline campaign #240 can an agent be dispatched to right now? List the most important first.
phrasings.short: tasks under #240 dispatchable now, most important first
phrasings.paraphrased: I have a free agent for Asset pipeline v2 (#240): what could it pick up at this moment, highest priority first?

gold_query: MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.ready AND t IN subtree(#240) RETURN t ORDER BY t.priority, t.topo, t.id LIMIT 20
notes: SD §11.1: on main only #252 and #901 in #240's tree are ready, both P2, so the order is by priority alone. #245 is unblocked but settled on lane/assets, #249 and #250 inherit #245's block through #248, #240 and #248 are containers, and #242 is in progress.

phrasings.literal: In the net lane (lane/net), which tasks of the netcode snapshots campaign #273 can an agent be dispatched to right now? List the most important first.
phrasings.short: lane/net: tasks under #273 dispatchable now, by priority
phrasings.paraphrased: Looking at the net lane's version of the store, what work under Netcode snapshots (#273) is up for grabs at this moment, highest priority first?

gold_query: USE lane/net MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.ready AND t IN subtree(#273) RETURN t ORDER BY t.priority
notes: SD §11.3: the named ready set on lane/net is #252, #278, #279, #291, #294, #901, #1401; of these #278 (P2), #1401 (P2, lane-only, SD §5.5) and #279 (P3) are in #273's tree. There #274 and #275 are done, #276 is in progress under LS-276, #277 is conflicted, #280 waits on #276 and #1402 on #1401.

phrasings.literal: Какие задачи из кампании #260 на ветке lane/audio агент может взять в работу прямо сейчас?
phrasings.short: lane/audio: задачи под #260, которые можно взять сейчас
phrasings.paraphrased: Если смотреть на аудио-ветку (lane/audio), что из переписывания микшера (#260) можно прямо сейчас отдать свободному агенту?

gold_query: USE lane/audio MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.ready AND t IN subtree(#260) RETURN t
notes: SD §11.2: on lane/audio #261 and #262 are done, so #263 (blocked by #261 on main) is in that lane's ready set and is the only ready task in #260's tree. #264 is in progress under LS-264, #265 is deferred to 2026-06-17, #266 waits on the open question #272, #267 is frozen and #260 is a container.

phrasings.literal: In the assets lane (lane/assets), which tasks under the import validation container #248 can an agent be dispatched to right now?
phrasings.short: lane/assets: dispatchable tasks under #248 now
phrasings.paraphrased: On the assets lane, can any of the Import validation work (#248) be handed to an agent at this moment, and which pieces?

gold_query: USE lane/assets MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.ready AND t IN subtree(#248) RETURN t
notes: SD §11.4: on lane/assets #245 is done, so its exogenous edge to #248 no longer blocks #248's children and #249 and #250 are in that lane's ready set; #248 is a container. On main the same two tasks are blocked by inheritance (SD §11.1).

phrasings.literal: Which open P0 tasks have no unfinished prerequisites, yet cannot be handed to an agent right now?
phrasings.short: P0 tasks with no open prerequisites but not dispatchable
phrasings.paraphrased: Among the top-priority (P0) work, what is clear of blockers but would still not be offered to a free agent at this moment?

gold_query: MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.priority = 0 AND t.unblocked AND NOT t.ready RETURN t
notes: SD §13: the P0 tasks are #261, #276 and #277, all open. SD §11.1: #261 and #276 are unblocked but not ready (#261 is settled on lane/audio, #276 is held under the live lease LS-276 of SD §8.1), and #277 waits on #276.

phrasings.literal: Which tasks are waiting on more than one unfinished prerequisite, and how many unfinished prerequisites does each of them have?
phrasings.short: tasks with two or more unfinished prerequisites, with counts
phrasings.paraphrased: Where is work stacked up behind several open dependencies at once? List each such task with its number of not-yet-done prerequisites.

gold_query: MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.open_blockers > 1 RETURN t, t.open_blockers
notes: SD §11.1: open_blockers is 2 for #246 (#242 in progress, #245 open) and 3 for #280 (#274, #275, #276). Every other named task has at most 1, including #242 whether or not its gating verdict counts (0 or 1, SD §16 item 1), and filler tasks have 0.

phrasings.literal: Which unfinished tasks have at least one unfinished task waiting on them, leaving out those already completed or cancelled on another branch?
phrasings.short: unfinished tasks others wait on, minus ones settled elsewhere
phrasings.paraphrased: List every task that is still holding up some not-yet-done work, but skip any whose work was already closed on another branch.

gold_query: MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.is_blocker AND NOT t.settled_elsewhere RETURN t ORDER BY t.id
notes: SD §11.1: is_blocker holds for the tasks #242, #245, #252, #261, #262, #274, #275, #276 and #294; #245, #261, #262, #274 and #275 are settled elsewhere, which leaves std.blocking = #242, #252, #276, #294. The blocking questions #225 and #272 are not tasks, and filler has no BLOCKS edge.

phrasings.literal: What is config hot reload task #295 waiting on before it can start?
phrasings.short: what #295 waits on
phrasings.paraphrased: Config hot reload (#295) is stuck: which piece of work has to be finished first?

gold_query: CALL blockers(#295) YIELD blocker RETURN blocker
notes: SD §5.8 and §6: the edge #293 -> #295 was re-pointed to #294 -> #295 when #293 was deleted with replacement #294 (c.x1-delete). SD §11.5: blockers(#295) is (#294, 1, -, direct, false, -); the raw BLOCKS in-edge gives the same node.

phrasings.literal: What is keeping snapshot interpolation #280 from starting, and for each such blocker, on which branch has it already been finished, if any?
phrasings.short: blockers of #280, with the branch each is already settled on
phrasings.paraphrased: Snapshot interpolation (#280) cannot begin: list what it waits on and, for each, the lane where that work was already closed, if there is one.

gold_query: CALL blockers(#280) YIELD blocker, elsewhere RETURN blocker, elsewhere
notes: SD §11.5: blockers(#280) on main lists #274 and #275 with elsewhere lane/net (both done there, SD §11.3) and #276 with no elsewhere branch (it is in progress on lane/net). All three are direct blockers.

phrasings.literal: What blocks #249 at any depth, including blockers it inherits from its parent tasks, and through which task does each blocker reach it?
phrasings.short: all blockers of #249, inherited included, with the via task
phrasings.paraphrased: Texture-size validation (#249) cannot start. Walk its whole blocker chain, parent-inherited blockers included, and give each blocker with the task it comes through.

gold_query: CALL blockers(#249, transitive: true) YIELD blocker, via RETURN blocker, via
notes: SD §6: #245 -> #248 is exogenous for #248's children, and #249 has no BLOCKS in-edge of its own. SD §11.5: blockers(#249, transitive: true) is the single row (#245, 1, #248, inherited, false, lane/assets). The named form takes the boolean in argv (k=v).

phrasings.literal: What is blocking crash report upload #297, and is each blocker a dangling link left behind by a deletion?
phrasings.short: blockers of #297 and whether each link is dangling
phrasings.paraphrased: Why is #297 (crash report upload) still stuck? Name what it waits on and say, for each, whether it is a dangling leftover of a deletion.

gold_query: CALL blockers(#297) YIELD blocker, flagged RETURN blocker, flagged
notes: SD §5.8 and §6: #296 was deleted without replacement (c.x4-delete), so its BLOCKS edge to #297 is flagged and #297 has_dangling. SD §11.5: blockers(#297) is (#296, 1, -, direct, true, -).

phrasings.literal: Что мешает начать задачу #266 и к какому виду относится узел, который её блокирует?
phrasings.short: что блокирует #266 и какого вида этот узел
phrasings.paraphrased: Спектральный анализатор (#266) никак не стартует: чего он ждёт и что это за узел — задача, вопрос или что-то ещё?

gold_query: CALL blockers(#266) YIELD blocker RETURN blocker, blocker.kind
notes: SD §6: #272 BLOCKS #266 (question to task, c.campaign-b). SD §11.5: blockers(#266) is (#272, 1, -, direct, false, -), and #272 (QB-bus) is an open question (SD §5.2).

phrasings.literal: Inside the asset pipeline campaign #240, which tasks are still holding up unfinished work that waits on them? Leave out any task already completed or cancelled on a lane.
phrasings.short: #240 tasks blocking unfinished work, not settled on a lane
phrasings.paraphrased: Which parts of Asset pipeline v2 (#240) are bottlenecks right now, unfinished and still gating other open work, not counting those already closed out in some lane?

gold_query: MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.is_blocker AND NOT t.settled_elsewhere AND t IN subtree(#240) RETURN t ORDER BY t.id
notes: SD §11.1: in #240's tree is_blocker holds for #242 (blocks #246), #245 (blocks #246 and #248) and #252 (blocks #251); #245 is settled on lane/assets, so std.blocking with scope #240 is #242 and #252.

phrasings.literal: Which tasks are connected to #246 by a chain of must-finish-before links in which every task along the chain, except #246 itself, is still unfinished?
phrasings.short: tasks upstream of #246 through chains of unfinished tasks only
phrasings.paraphrased: Trace the prerequisite chains that end at the mesh importer (#246), passing only through work that is not done yet: which tasks lie on those chains?

gold_query: MATCH (x:task)((a:task)-[:BLOCKS]->(b) WHERE a.unfinished)+(#246) RETURN x
notes: SD §6: the BLOCKS edges into #246 come from #242 (in progress) and #245 (open); the edges into #245 come from #241 and #243, both done (SD §5.3), so no qualifying step reaches further. A plain closure would add #241 and #243.

phrasings.literal: For each task labelled campaign, what percentage of its direct subtasks are closed, counting completed and cancelled ones alike, rounded to one decimal place?
phrasings.short: per campaign task: % of direct subtasks done or cancelled, one decimal
phrasings.paraphrased: Give me a closure rate per campaign: for every campaign-labelled task, the share of its immediate subtasks that are finished or called off, as a percentage to one decimal.

gold_query: MATCH (t:task)-[:CHILD_OF]->(c:task) WHERE 'campaign' IN c.labels RETURN c, round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN t.done THEN 1 END) / count(*), 1) AS pct
notes: SD §13: the tasks labelled campaign are #240, #260 and #273. On main #240 has 13 children, 5 done or cancelled (#241, #243, #244; #253, #902): 38.46, rounded 38.5; #260 has 7 with none closed (#267 is frozen): 0.0; #273 has 8 with only #281 cancelled: 12.5 (SD §5.3-§5.5, [AR §3.1] virtual done; `/` is a float, [50 §3.3]).

phrasings.literal: Lower bandwidth budget task #279 to P4, but only if it is still open, still at P3 and has no assignee; change nothing else.
phrasings.short: drop #279 to P4 if open, P3 and unassigned
phrasings.paraphrased: Deprioritise #279 (bandwidth budget) to P4, provided nobody has started it, it still sits at P3 and no one is assigned to it.

gold_query: TX { MATCH (t {id: #279}) WHERE t.status = 'open' AND t.priority = 3 AND t.assignee IS NULL EXPECT 1 SET t.priority = 4 }
notes: SD §5.5 and §11.1: #279 is open at P3 on main, and SD §13 does not list it among the 16 tasks with an assignee, so the guard matches exactly #279.

phrasings.literal: Raise every task in the netcode snapshots campaign #273 that can be dispatched right now to P1, expecting exactly two such tasks, and make the change only if afterwards no unfinished task in #273 is left at P3.
phrasings.short: dispatchable tasks under #273 to P1 (two); then none unfinished at P3
phrasings.paraphrased: Bump the two currently dispatchable tasks in Netcode snapshots (#273) to P1, and refuse the whole change if any not-yet-done work under #273 would still sit at P3.

gold_query: TX { MATCH (t:task) WHERE t.ready AND t IN subtree(#273) EXPECT 2 SET t.priority = 1; ASSERT COUNT { MATCH (x:task) WHERE x IN subtree(#273) AND x.unfinished AND x.priority = 3 } = 0 ELSE 'unfinished P3 work left under #273' }
notes: SD §11.1: the ready tasks in #273's tree on main are #278 (P2) and #279 (P3). After the change the only P3 task in the tree is #281, which is cancelled (SD §5.5), so the assertion holds and the block commits.

phrasings.literal: Assign shader hot reload task #291 to dev#4, but only if main is still at commit {{commit:c.filler-d13}}; if main has moved, change nothing.
phrasings.short: assign #291 to dev#4 if main tip is {{commit:c.filler-d13}}
phrasings.paraphrased: Provided nobody has committed to main since {{commit:c.filler-d13}}, hand the shader hot reload work (#291) to dev#4.

gold_query: TX IF TIP {{commit:c.filler-d13}} { SET #291.assignee = 'dev#4' }
notes: SD §3.1 and §11.6: main's tip at NOW is c.filler-d13, so the tip guard passes on the pristine store. SD §5.7 and §13: #291 has no assignee, so the row goes from absent to dev#4.

phrasings.literal: On the net lane (lane/net), holding lease {{lease:LS-276}}, complete server tick clock task #276 as done with the summary 'tick stamping done'.
phrasings.short: lane/net: complete #276 under lease {{lease:LS-276}}, summary 'tick stamping done'
phrasings.paraphrased: You hold lease {{lease:LS-276}} in the net lane: close out #276 (server tick clock) as finished and record 'tick stamping done' as its summary.

gold_query: TX ON lane/net LEASE '{{lease:LS-276}}' { CALL tx.complete(#276, outcome: 'done', summary: 'tick stamping done') }
notes: SD §8.1 and §11.3: LS-276 is dev#2's live lease on #276 on lane/net, where #276 is in progress with no children and no gating verdict. The resolution, the lease release, the settled marker and #280 becoming unblocked on lane/net are implied rows (README §7.5).

phrasings.literal: The tester has finished measuring mixer latency for task #264 in the audio lane (lane/audio); using lease {{lease:LS-264}}, record the task as done with the summary 'latency measured'.
phrasings.short: record #264 done in lane/audio, lease {{lease:LS-264}}, summary 'latency measured'
phrasings.paraphrased: Mark the mixer latency measurement (#264) complete on lane/audio under the tester's lease {{lease:LS-264}}, noting 'latency measured' as the summary.

gold_query: TX ON lane/audio LEASE '{{lease:LS-264}}' { CALL tx.complete(#264, outcome: 'done', summary: 'latency measured') }
notes: SD §8.1 and §11.2: LS-264 is test#1's live lease on #264 on lane/audio, where #264 is in progress; #262 is done there, so nothing blocks it, and it has no children or gating verdict. The resolution, the lease release and the settled marker are implied rows.

phrasings.literal: Record a round-2 review finding C8 about the importers section #257, titled 'Retries unbounded', severity important, kind correctness, failure scenario 'Corrupt input loops'; do nothing if a round-2 finding C8 about #257 already exists.
phrasings.short: #257 finding C8/r2 'Retries unbounded', important/correctness, scenario 'Corrupt input loops', if absent
phrasings.paraphrased: Unless the Importers section (#257) already carries a round-2 finding C8, add one: 'Retries unbounded', important, a correctness issue, failure scenario 'Corrupt input loops'.

gold_query: TX { CREATE (f:finding {title: 'Retries unbounded', local_id: 'C8', round: 2, severity: 'important', f_kind: 'correctness', failure_scenario: 'Corrupt input loops'})-[:ABOUT]->(#257) UNLESS EXISTS { MATCH (f:finding)-[:ABOUT]->(#257) WHERE f.local_id = 'C8' AND f.round = 2 } }
notes: SD §6: the findings about #257 are #502 (C2, round 1) and #802 (C6, round 2), so no round-2 C8 exists and the statement creates #2001 (new1, SD §2.5) with its ABOUT edge. Field values set at creation are listed under created; the ABOUT row sits on the finding, the edge's stored source.

phrasings.literal: Create a new P1 task 'Snapshot delta fuzzing' under the netcode snapshots campaign #273 that cannot start until delta encoder task #275 is finished.
phrasings.short: new P1 task 'Snapshot delta fuzzing' under #273, waiting on #275
phrasings.paraphrased: Add 'Snapshot delta fuzzing' as a P1 subtask of Netcode snapshots (#273); the delta encoder (#275) has to be done before it can begin.

gold_query: TX { CREATE (t:task {title: 'Snapshot delta fuzzing', priority: 1})-[:BLOCKED_BY]->(#275) UNDER #273 }
notes: SD §2.5: the first created node is #2001 (new1). BLOCKED_BY is the reverse alias of BLOCKS, so the stored edge is #275 BLOCKS #2001 and its row sits on #275 ([50 §2.5]); UNDER #273 sets the parent. #275 and the new task are both in #273's tree, so no exogenous edge is implied.

phrasings.literal: Record that mixer UI panel task #265 must not start until resampler task #263 is finished.
phrasings.short: #265 cannot start before #263 finishes
phrasings.paraphrased: The mixer UI panel (#265) depends on the resampler (#263): add that prerequisite so the panel waits for it.

gold_query: TX { CREATE (#263)-[:BLOCKS]->(#265) }
notes: SD §6: no edge joins #263 and #265 and no path leads from #265 to #263, so the new edge keeps the precedence graph acyclic. Its stored source is #263, the task that finishes first; #265's derived flags are implied rows.

phrasings.literal: Remove only the direct prerequisite link saying #274 must finish before #280 starts; #280 still waits on #274 through #275, and every other link stays.
phrasings.short: remove only the direct prerequisite link #274 before #280
phrasings.paraphrased: The direct prerequisite from the snapshot ring buffer (#274) to snapshot interpolation (#280) is redundant, since the same dependency also runs via #275; delete just that one link.

gold_query: TX { MATCH (#274)-[e:BLOCKS]->(#280) EXPECT 1 DELETE e }
notes: SD §6: #274 -> #280 is the shortcut beside #274 -> #275 -> #280 (c.campaign-c). Deleting it removes one edge; #280's open_blockers falling from 3 to 2 is an implied row.

phrasings.literal: Move packet loss simulator task #278 out of the netcode snapshots campaign and place it under the build tooling cleanup task #285.
phrasings.short: move #278 under #285
phrasings.paraphrased: Re-home the packet loss simulator (#278): its parent should be build tooling cleanup (#285) rather than Netcode snapshots.

gold_query: TX { MOVE #278 UNDER #285 }
notes: SD §5.5 and §6: #278 is a child of #273 on main and has no BLOCKS edge there (#279 -> #278 exists only on plan/q3), so the move re-parents it with no exogenous edge to re-derive; plan/q3 made the same move at c.plan-reprio (SD §7 s88). The rollups of #273 and #285 are implied rows.

phrasings.literal: Reopen manifest schema task #241, but only if it is currently completed, with the reason 'manifest version field regressed'.
phrasings.short: reopen #241 if done, reason 'manifest version field regressed'
phrasings.paraphrased: The asset manifest schema work (#241) needs another pass: if it is marked done, send it back to open, citing 'manifest version field regressed'.

gold_query: TX { MATCH (t {id: #241}) WHERE t.status = 'done' EXPECT 1 REOPEN t REASON 'manifest version field regressed' }
notes: SD §5.3 and §11.1: #241 is done on main (c.a1-done). REOPEN is the only way from done back to open ([50 §3.10]); the reopen_count increment and #245 becoming blocked again are implied rows.

phrasings.literal: Delete duplicate task #902 for good, recording #242 as its replacement, with the reason 'duplicate task'.
phrasings.short: delete #902, replaced by #242, reason 'duplicate task'
phrasings.paraphrased: Hash the asset store (#902) only duplicated #242: remove it permanently, naming #242 as the replacement and giving 'duplicate task' as the reason.

gold_query: TX { DELETE #902 REPLACED BY #242 REASON 'duplicate task' }
notes: SD §5.3 and §6: #902 is a cancelled child of #240 with the out-edges CHILD_OF #240 and DUPLICATE_OF #242, no in-edge, no lease and no restricting reference. The dropped out-edges, the tombstone fields, #240's rollups and the deleted marker are implied rows of the DELETE (README §7.5).

phrasings.literal: On the staging ref merge/lane/assets/from/main, resolve the dangling link saying #252 must finish before the deleted #251 by re-pointing it to #251's replacement #1400.
phrasings.short: merge/lane/assets/from/main: repoint dangling #252-to-#251 link onto #1400
phrasings.paraphrased: The staged merge of the assets lane is held up because #252 still has to finish before #251, which the lane deleted in favour of #1400; fix it on the staging ref by pointing that prerequisite at #1400.

gold_query: TX ON merge/lane/assets/from/main { RESOLVE 'edge:#252:blocks:#251' TAKE REPOINT #1400 }
notes: SD §10: the staged violation has key edge:#252:blocks:#251, class DanglingEdge, suggested resolution REPOINT #1400, and the staging ref accepts only RESOLVE ([50 §3.9] item 6). The gold writes the re-pointed edge as the removal of #252 BLOCKS #251 plus the addition of #252 BLOCKS #1400.

phrasings.literal: On the assets lane (lane/assets), set every unfinished task at any depth under the import validation container #248 to P1; there should be exactly two.
phrasings.short: lane/assets: all unfinished tasks under #248 to P1, expect two
phrasings.paraphrased: In the assets lane, bump all not-yet-done work beneath Import validation (#248), however deep, to P1; two tasks are expected.

gold_query: TX ON lane/assets { MATCH (t:task)-[:CHILD_OF]->+(#248) WHERE t.unfinished EXPECT 2 SET t.priority = 1 }
notes: SD §5.3 and §11.4: on lane/assets #248's tree holds #249 (P2) and #250 (P3), both open; no commit of the lane or of plan/q3 changes their priorities (SD §7).

phrasings.literal: Подними до P0 все задачи, до которых от #274 можно дойти по цепочке связей «должна завершиться раньше», если каждая задача на этой цепочке после #274 ещё открыта.
phrasings.short: до P0: открытые задачи, ждущие #274 через цепочку открытых задач
phrasings.paraphrased: Всё, что прямо или через другие открытые задачи ждёт завершения кольцевого буфера снимков (#274), переведи в P0, но иди только по открытым задачам.

gold_query: TX { MATCH (#274)((a)-[:BLOCKS]->(b:task) WHERE b.status = 'open')+(t) EXPECT 2 SET t.priority = 0 }
notes: SD §6: #274 blocks #275 and #280, and #275 blocks #280; both are open on main (SD §11.1), so the walk from #274 through open successors reaches exactly #275 and #280, each at P1 (SD §5.5).
